name: Time
description: The above condition can be used in the entry block if you don't want to take new positions after 3:00 PM.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the current time as HHMM, do not use any special characters

![Example](./images/img-1631798543.png)

The above condition will be true if the time is 09:20 AM. Time keyword is widely used to control the entry and exits

![Example](./images/img-1631798646.png)

The above condition can be used in the entry block if you don't want to take new positions after 3:00 PM.

![Example](./images/img-1631798737.png)

The above condition can be used in universal exit to exit the strategy at 15:15

Please note- Use only integers and not any special characters
